title: Email verification code field has no accessible name
steps: Register a new account locally; inspect the accessibility tree on 'Check your email'.
expected: The code input is announced as e.g. 'Verification code, 6 digits'.
actual: Accessibility snapshot shows an unnamed textbox next to 'Verify email'.
impact: Screen-reader users hear 'edit text' with no purpose on the step that gates every new account.
fix: Add aria-label='Verification code' (or a visible <Label htmlFor>) plus autocomplete='one-time-code' and inputmode='numeric'. Full a11y sweep follows in Wave 4.
